title: Sparkly guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8a030'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#c06020'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a04010'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='soundGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a0a00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a1800'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='8' width='8' height='38' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='46' y='8' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#a07040'/>

  <!-- frets -->
  <rect x='46' y='16' width='8' height='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>
  <rect x='46' y='24' width='8' height='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>
  <rect x='46' y='32' width='8' height='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>
  <rect x='46' y='40' width='8' height='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>

  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='44' y='2' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#6b3a1b'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='6' r='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='6' r='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='3.5' r='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='3.5' r='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>

  <!-- upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='18' ry='14' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='18' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#f0c060' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- waist detail -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='15' ry='8' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='16' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#f0c060' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='7' fill='url(#soundGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#f0c060' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- pickguard -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='68' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#d04030' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='43' y='80' width='14' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2a0a'/>
  <rect x='43' y='80' width='14' height='1.5' rx='1.5' fill='#e0c080'/>

  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='49' y1='8' x2='48' y2='81' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.7' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='49.5' y2='81' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.7' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='8' x2='51' y2='81' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.7' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='8' x2='52.5' y2='81' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.7' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe040'>
    <path d='M20,30 L22,25 L24,30 L22,35 Z'/>
    <path d='M78,25 L80,20 L82,25 L80,30 Z'/>
    <path d='M15,60 L17,55 L19,60 L17,65 Z'/>
    <path d='M82,58 L84,53 L86,58 L84,63 Z'/>
    <path d='M25,80 L26.5,76 L28,80 L26.5,84 Z'/>
    <path d='M72,82 L73.5,78 L75,82 L73.5,86 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <path d='M28,18 L29,15 L30,18 L29,21 Z'/>
    <path d='M70,40 L71.5,36.5 L73,40 L71.5,43.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M12,48 L13,45 L14,48 L13,51 Z'/>
    <path d='M85,42 L86,39 L87,42 L86,45 Z'/>
    <path d='M20,68 L21,65.5 L22,68 L21,70.5 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#a0e0ff'>
    <path d='M33,38 L34,35 L35,38 L34,41 Z'/>
    <path d='M67,15 L68,12 L69,15 L68,18 Z'/>
    <path d='M78,72 L79,69 L80,72 L79,75 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
